answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Letterboxing club tenure with stamp collection record is the check: stamps collected across one moor for years. A farm faking 464 aliases needs 464 separate stamp records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the cipher signal is public, the island check is automatic, and 464 aliases cost 464 times what one real agent costs, with the whisper trail open to all.
